units.setIn: Set in Australia. All amounts are in Australian dollars.

high.label: New 1-bed in the inner city
high.diary: I signed a lease on a new one-bedroom in the inner city. The rent is steep, but everything is close by.

mid.label: 1-bed unit in the suburbs
mid.diary: I signed a lease on a one-bedroom unit in the suburbs. My new life starts here.

low.label: Older studio further out
low.diary: I signed a lease on an older studio further out. To make up for the cheap rent, I leave a little earlier each morning.

high.label: New, top models
high.diary: I got brand-new top-model appliances and furniture. The room suddenly felt like my own castle.

mid.label: New, from IKEA / Kmart
mid.diary: I furnished the place with new, basic pieces from IKEA and Kmart.

low.label: Secondhand / hand-me-downs
low.diary: I furnished the place from Facebook Marketplace and hand-me-downs from mates. If it works, it's good enough.

high.label: Mostly cafés, takeaway and delivery
high.diary: I mostly eat at cafés or order takeaway. I barely use the kitchen.

mid.label: Half cooking, half eating out
mid.diary: I decided to cook on weekdays and eat out now and then on weekends.

low.label: As cheap as possible (Aldi, cooking at home)
low.diary: Food on the cheap, no matter what. Rice, mince and pasta became my best friends.

food.same: I decided to keep eating the way I do now.

high.label: Go to everything
high.diary: Drinks at the pub, get-togethers — I decided to go to everything I'm invited to.

mid.label: In moderation
mid.diary: I decided to socialise in moderation, only when I want to go.

low.label: Only when needed
low.diary: I decided to show up only when I really need to.

skip.diary: I decided to turn down most invitations. More time to myself.

social.same: I decided to keep socialising the way I do now.

high.label: All in
high.diary: I decided to go all in on my hobbies and supporting my favourite artists.

mid.label: In moderation
mid.diary: I decided to enjoy my hobbies within reason.

low.label: No spending
low.diary: I decided to enjoy my hobbies without spending money.

skip.diary: I decided to give up my hobbies. I spend more days off at home now.

hobby.same: I decided to keep my hobbies as they are.

high.label: Part-time graduate certificate
high.diary: I started a part-time graduate certificate after work. I'll give it my best for 2 years.

mid.label: TAFE course / certification
mid.pass: I earned a certificate through a TAFE course. My income rose {pct}%.

low.label: Self-study
low.pass: I passed the certification exam by studying on my own. My income rose {pct}%.
low.fail: I took the exam after studying on my own, but didn't pass.

skip.diary: I decided not to invest in myself for now.

mid.label: Used car (good condition)
mid.diary: I bought a used car in good condition.

low.label: Cheap used car
low.diary: I bought a cheap used car. As long as it runs.

car.skip: I decided not to buy a car for now.
car.never: I decided not to own a car. Public transport and my bike will do.

high.label: Trip to Japan or Europe
high.diary: I splurged on a trip to Japan.

mid.label: Bali or a domestic trip
mid.diary: I went to Bali for a week. A nice break.

low.label: Day trip nearby
low.diary: I went on a day trip nearby.

high.label: Spend freely on dates
high.diary: I decided not to hold back on time with my partner.

mid.label: In moderation
mid.diary: I decided to go out with my partner within reason.

low.label: Budget dates
low.diary: I decided to enjoy low-cost time together with my partner.

high.label: Matchmaking agency
high.diary: I signed up with a matchmaking service.

mid.label: Paid dating app
mid.diary: I started using a paid dating app.

low.label: Free apps / introductions
low.diary: I decided to look for someone through free apps and introductions from friends.

skip.diary: I decided not to look for a partner to marry.

high.label: Hens/bucks + the wedding
high.diary: I went to my mate's hens/bucks party and the wedding interstate.

mid.label: Attend
mid.diary: I went to my friend's wedding.

low.label: Skip it, send a gift
low.diary: I couldn't make my friend's wedding, so I sent a gift instead.

S.comment: Hardly any money worries. You can step into the next chapter traveling light.

A.comment: You enjoyed yourself where it counted and still saved well.

B.comment: No luxuries, but no troubles either. You run your own life just fine.

C.comment: Not much saved, but no debt. The real story starts now.

D.comment: A credit card balance is left over. First things first: pay it off.

married_high.name: A New Life for Two
married_high.comment: At the end of all those happy days was someone to walk beside.

married_mid.name: An Ordinary Marriage
married_mid.comment: Nothing flashy, but a calm new life begins.

married_low.name: Married on Impulse
married_low.comment: Worn out by everyday life, you decided to get married. Time to get back on your feet.

single_high.name: Happily Single
single_high.comment: A life of your own, surrounded by things you love. You'll keep living light.

single_mid.name: At My Own Pace
single_mid.comment: Not matching anyone else's rhythm — just living at your own pace.

single_low.name: Only Money to Talk To
single_low.comment: The numbers in your bank account went up, but there's no one to talk to.

bankrupt.name: Bankrupt Ending
bankrupt.comment: Debts piled up and life became unmanageable. Look back at where you overreached, and try again.

oshi.name: Fandom Is Life
oshi.desc: Chose "All in" every time for hobbies & fandom (2+ times)

frugal.name: Master of Thrift
frugal.desc: Chose "Low" or skipped in 70%+ of choices

social.name: Social Butterfly
social.desc: Chose "Go to everything" every time for socialising (2+ times)

carFree.name: Car-Free Life
carFree.desc: Chose never to own a car

fate.name: Meant to Be
fate.desc: Reached a married ending without a partner search

agency.name: Search Pays Off
agency.desc: Reached a married ending through a matchmaking agency

happy.name: Every Day Is Fun
happy.desc: Finished with fulfillment of 90 or more

noCardLoan.name: Debt-Free
noCardLoan.desc: Finished without savings ever going negative

bigWindfall.name: Unexpected Fortune
bigWindfall.desc: Got a windfall of A$5,000 or more

continued.name: The Story Continues
continued.desc: Pressed the button to continue in Newlywed Diary
